name: postmcp
description: Send real paper letters, plain or registered, anywhere in Europe.

interface.longDescription:
BeyondSky Post prints a letter and posts it for you, anywhere in Europe (34 countries). Write the letter with ChatGPT or attach a PDF or Word file. It lays it out, shows you a preview and the exact price, and gives you a payment page on getpostmcp.com. After payment the letter is printed, put in an envelope and handed to the postal service. You get an email when it is posted, with tracking for registered mail.

Use it for cancellation letters, letters to a landlord, an insurer, a public office or a company, formal notices, or any letter you would otherwise print and take to the post office.

Registered letters are available to Germany, Spain, France, Switzerland and Belgium. Nothing is printed or charged before you pay.

Limits: A4, up to 20 pages, destinations in the EU, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco and Andorra. Letters with threats, scams or impersonation are refused.
defaultPrompt: Send a letter to my landlord to end my lease
Send a registered letter to my insurer in Germany
Post this PDF to my insurer

publication.release_notes: Listing renamed to BeyondSky Post (no "MCP" in the name). Plain and registered letters across Europe.

positive.description: Get the price of a plain letter to Germany
positive.prompt: How much does it cost to send a 2-page letter to Berlin, Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: get_quote is called with country DE, pages 2, service standard. The assistant answers 3.24 € including VAT (2.49 € first page, 0.25 € extra page, 0.50 € delivery outside France). No letter is created.

positive.description: Get the price of a registered letter to France
positive.prompt: What is the price of a 1-page registered letter to Paris?
positive.expected_behavior: get_quote is called with country FR, pages 1, service registered. The assistant answers 11.99 € including VAT. No letter is created.

positive.description: Write and send a plain letter (payment link flow)
positive.prompt: Send a letter to Hausverwaltung Mueller, Hauptstrasse 12, 10115 Berlin, Germany, saying I end my lease on 31 December. Sender: Jane Doe, 10 rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France. My email is jane.doe@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant drafts the letter, shows the recipient, sender and text and asks the user to confirm. After confirmation it calls send_letter (service standard, country DE). The result gives a letter id, the page count, the total price including VAT, a preview link and a payment page link on getpostmcp.com. The assistant tells the user the letter is only printed and posted after payment. Nothing is charged or mailed during the test.

positive.description: Check the status of a letter
positive.prompt: Where is the letter you just created for me? (follow-up to test case 3)
positive.expected_behavior: get_letter_status is called with the letter id from test case 3. The assistant reports the status awaiting_payment, the recipient, the price and the payment page link, and explains the letter is posted once paid.

positive.description: Send a registered letter to Spain
positive.prompt: Send a registered letter to Seguros Ejemplo SA, Calle Mayor 1, 28013 Madrid, Spain, to cancel my home insurance policy number 12345 at the end of the term. Sender: Jane Doe, 10 rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France, jane.doe@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant drafts the cancellation letter and asks the user to confirm the details. It then calls send_letter with service registered and country ES. The result shows a total of 8.99 € including VAT for one page, a preview link and a payment page link on getpostmcp.com. Nothing is charged or mailed during the test.

negative.description: Sending an email, not a paper letter
negative.prompt: Email my landlord at landlord@example.com that the heating is broken.
Ship a 2 kg box of books from Paris to my sister in Rome.

negative.description: Writing help only, no mailing requested
negative.prompt: Help me write a cover letter for a marketing job. I will send it myself through the company website.
